decisions.reason: The MQL system sits close to the firm's established modular fluid-handling offer and was visibly presented on its own page; dropping it would write off sunk development and expose the launch decision, and any weak results can still be blamed on the temporary pandemic slump in machine-tool demand.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's core filtration platform, so investment and public commitment are substantial, and the missing web evidence for 2020-2021 reflects a lack of archiving rather than withdrawal, so management would persist.

The gravity band filter is a natural part of the modular coolant-filtration range the firm has publicly committed to, costs little to keep alongside existing platforms, and disappointing sales could be attributed to temporary market conditions.
